# Divyavani (v2.0)
> AI-Powered Educational Doubt-Solving & Multi-Tab Chapter Workspace
> Original Concept by Vanshika & Divyanshi (Class IX-H)

## Overview
Divyavani is an open educational workspace for Class IX CBSE students providing Socratic, step-by-step doubt resolutions alongside a multi-tab chapter document reader.

## Architecture
- Double-Palette Block Design: Obsidian Black (#09090B) and Pure Alabaster (#FFFFFF) with 1.5px structural borders.
- Security Constitution: OWASP Top 10, DOMPurify sanitization, XML prompt boundary (<student_query>), Zod validation, UUIDv4.
- WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant.
